name: @w6w-apps/zendesk
description: Manage Zendesk Support tickets, users and organizations.

w6w.longDescription:
Zendesk manages the full ticket lifecycle from a workflow — creating, updating, searching, fetching, listing and deleting tickets, and adding comments to keep a conversation moving without an agent working inside Zendesk's own interface. Ticket fields can be listed too, so a workflow can populate a custom field correctly rather than guessing at what a Zendesk instance has configured.

Users and organizations round it out: users can be created, searched, fetched, deleted and upserted with a single create-or-update action, and organizations can be created, fetched and listed, giving a workflow what it needs to file a ticket against the right requester and account.

A fit for routing an external event — a support email, an alert, a form submission — into a new Zendesk ticket, or syncing user and organization records between Zendesk and a CRM.
